headline: Israeli attacks kill at least four Palestinians in Gaza despite the year-old ceasefire
dek: At least four Palestinians, including a couple (Akram Yassin and his wife Dina Abu Baker, killed in a Gaza City apartment strike) and a 17-year-old, were killed in Israeli air attacks and gunfire in separate Gaza incidents on Tuesday Nov 3, per health officials/medics via AJ. A BBC-mirror version…
sources: Al Jazeera report citing medics/health officials; Gaza health ministry figures; BBC-mirror version citing hospitals
fault_line: Ceasefire on paper or war in reality — after a year of truce and 1,500+ killed since it took effect, is the Gaza ceasefire still a ceasefire at all?

sections.what_happened: At least four Palestinians, including a couple (Akram Yassin and his wife Dina Abu Baker, killed in a Gaza City apartment strike) and a 17-year-old, were killed in Israeli air attacks and gunfire in separate Gaza incidents on Tuesday Nov 3, per health officials/medics via AJ. A BBC-mirror version of the same incident set reports 8 killed including a child, including 5 police officers killed by a drone attack in Al-Mawasi, Khan Younis, while on routine duties. Cumulative figures carried: 74,480+ killed since October 2023; 1,522 killed and 5,421 wounded since the October 2025 ceasefire, with 839 bodies recovered from rubble (AJ version; other versions carry 1,580/1,593 — scope/date differences between outlets, not reconciled here). Israel says it targets Hamas; no IDF comment on the Gaza City attack was carried in the versions checked.
sections.what_verified: 1 tiered family (Al Jazeera, T2 STATE (QA)) for the AJ incident set; the BBC-mirror page is an unofficial mirror domain and does NOT count as a BBC family corroboration.
sections.what_disputed: Scope discrepancy: AJ 'at least four' vs BBC-mirror 'eight including a child' for overlapping Tuesday incidents — the higher figure includes the 5 Khan Younis police officers; treat as one incident set with outlet-scoped counts, not two separate tolls. Israel's position (targeting Hamas) is carried without an incident-specific IDF statement in the versions checked. Ceasefire framing contested on the ground: a bereaved relative told Reuters 'We're supposed to be in a ceasefire period, but honestly, we are not seeing a ceasefire.'
sections.why_matters: Monitor only: a daily-increment toll inside the proven Gaza-toll lane, but a single Tuesday incident set with conflicting outlet scopes (4 vs 8) cannot carry a clean counted-number Short. It becomes a Short only if a single-scope toll (e.g. health-ministry daily total) is confirmed.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (AJ report carried early Nov 4 , events Tuesday Nov 3): Israeli attacks kill at least four Palestinians in Gaza despite the year-old ceasefire; Gaza health ministry toll since ceasefire now 1,522+

totw_analysis: Our read: Monitor only: a daily-increment toll inside the proven Gaza-toll lane, but a single Tuesday incident set with conflicting outlet scopes (4 vs 8) cannot carry a clean counted-number Short. It becomes a Short only if a single-scope toll (e.g. health-ministry daily total) is confirmed. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Ceasefire on paper or war in reality — after a year of truce and 1,500+ killed since it took effect, is the Gaza ceasefire still a ceasefire at all?
